scenes.heading: EXT. FOREST CLEARING — DAWN, DAYS LATER

beats.text: Smoke still rises faintly in the distance. WILLKA, 60s, kneels beside Pillahuaso, who sits wrapped in a blanket, staring at nothing.

beats.speaker: Willka
beats.text: You've a name?
(No answer.)

beats.speaker: Willka
beats.text: Fine. Keep it, then. Come on — up. Sitting in the dirt won't feed you and it won't bring anyone back.
a series of short vignettes, lightly interactive — chopping wood, carrying water, first training-dummy strikes. Each vignette is brief, 30–90 seconds, stitched with time-skip transitions.

In one vignette, other camp children mock Pillahuaso for not speaking. He says nothing — his face doesn't move at all, even as they push him. One boy, embarrassed by the lack of a reaction, backs off first.

beats.speaker: Camp Boy
beats.direction: to another kid, muttering as they walk off
beats.text: His face doesn't do anything. Like a rock.

beats.speaker: Camp Boy 2
beats.text: Rumi... ñawi. Stone-face.
The name spreads through the camp within days, half mockery, half something closer to respect. We see Pillahuaso hear it for the first time, alone, practicing strikes against a post.

beats.speaker: Pillahuaso
beats.text: Rumiñahui.
He doesn't smile. But he doesn't correct the next person who says it, either.
Willka watches him drill, arms crossed.

beats.speaker: Willka
beats.text: You know why I don't call you by the name your mother gave you anymore?

beats.speaker: Rumiñahui
beats.text: Because you're old and forget things.

beats.speaker: Willka
beats.text: Because you stopped answering to it. A name is worth what a person is willing to be, boy. You decided what you're willing to be a long time before I had any say in it.
(Beat. Rumiñahui stops drilling.)

beats.speaker: Rumiñahui
beats.text: I froze.

beats.speaker: Willka
beats.text: You did.

beats.speaker: Rumiñahui
beats.text: I won't again.

beats.speaker: Willka
beats.text: I know. That's rather the problem with you, if I'm honest. But — later's problem. Again. From the top.
full combat tutorial resumes — light/heavy attack, dodge, block, taught over the remainder of the mission. Ends on the accepted name and the first real training bout, setting up M1.1.
